key_facts: On November 1, 2024, CHP Officers Meza-Gonzalez and Melano contacted Plaintiff on the I-580 East shoulder in Livermore (CHP Case RJ68845). The DS-367 chemical-test-refusal designation and Arrest Report triggered DMV APS Case 34739340. After a January 24, 2025 Microsoft Teams hearing, Hearing Officer Diana Candelaria issued a February 11, 2025 Decision sustaining a one-year Class A CDL suspension (Feb. 20, 2025 – Feb. 19, 2026) without addressing the November 5, 2024 PC § 849(b)(1) Detention Certificate. Matter 7 (federal §1983, 2:26-cv-00983-DC-CSK) and Matter 8 (state mandate, 26WM000135, abandoned) litigate that APS outcome. This matter consolidates the underlying incident/APS evidence and both Candelaria docket PDF sets under one owning folder.
procedural_status: Opened August 7, 2026 as Matter 33. Received: (a) six Nov. 1, 2024 / APS discovery PDFs plus Centerline wage reference into matter-33/incident/; (b) twelve Matter 7 Candelaria federal PDFs into matter-33/from-07/; (c) six Matter 8 mandamus PDFs into matter-33/from-08/; (d) the June 15, 2026 Candelaria F&R into matter-33/opinions/. Matters 1, 2, 7, 8, and 32 cross-reference these paths. No complaint has been filed under this Matter 33 caption — it is a document-home entry for the Candelaria / DMV APS slice of the CHP cluster.
damages: None separately demanded under this caption. Operative damages remain those pleaded in Matter 7 (and formerly Matter 8's equitable track). Matter 33 is documentary ownership only.
risk: Low as a document-home entry. Do not plead overlapping damages under Matter 33. Path updates for Matters 1/2/7/8/32 and outcomes.js already point at /documents/matter-33/.
